events.title: Moose Builders release date!
events.summary: The release date for Moose Builders is set! It is happening on November 23! So make sure to wishlist the game to get notified of the release. I also just released an update to the demo with the new voxel lighting. Patch notes for demo update: Demo patch notes 0.55 :: Moose Builders General Discussions

events.title: Moose News - Demo release date!
events.summary: The demo for Moose Builders will be released on August 31! With this the playtest will be deactivated as the demo will contain everything the playtest had and be the version that will be updated moving forward. So I want to thank everyone that tried out the playtest and left feedback. The demo has what will be the first tech tier of the game, the Crude tech tier. events.title: Moose News - Build an efficient solar farm
events.summary: Welcome back to Moose News, I’m currently working hard to get the last things done to make the playtest ready for release. While you wait for that, let me tell you how solar power works in the game. The main goal of the game is to build a giant solar farm to power your factory (and maybe something else towards the end game). events.title: Moose News - Merging anything to make it better
events.summary: Welcome to Moose News where you’ll get more in depth information about the game as I am getting it ready for release. Today I will describe the merge mechanic in Moose Builders. Everything (with a few exceptions) in the game can be merged by putting 4 of the same item into a Crafter. They will then be merged into 1 of a higher merge tier. There will be 16 merge tiers in the game which means the last merge tiers will be very expensive to craft. The different tiers are displayed with Roman numeral
